sloka: अंगदः तु कुमरो अयम् वनांतम् उपनिर्गतः ।प्रवृत्तिः तेन कथिता चारैः असीत् निवेदिता ॥४-१५-१६॥
transliteration: aṁgadaḥ tu kumaro ayam vanāṁtam upanirgataḥ ।pravṛttiḥ tena kathitā cāraiḥ asīt niveditā ॥4-15-16॥

translations.english: 'When our son Angada was out into the forest he had collected some reports from the spies which he has transmitted to me.
translations.hindi: स॒ तं दृष्टा महावीयं सुग्रीवं पयवस्थितम्‌ । गाढं परिदधे वासो वाली परमरोपणः
